utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—what’s the first thing you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Mara — I’m running a bit late as usual, but the first thing we need is a quick list of what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I can put that together. I’ll walk around and jot down the fixes I spot, then bring you a quick list.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds good — what’s the main thing you want help fixing?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I want to double-check the exact issue first—can you tell me what’s actually broken and whether you’ve already tried anything?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with that—just tell me what’s broken, and I’ll note whether you’ve already tried a reset or a quick fix.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’m checking what supplies we already have and what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what you’ve got in mind, Noah.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: I think I’ve got a few old tools in the shed, but I might be forgetting what’s actually there. I can take a look and let you know.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: That’d be great—just let me know what’s usable, and I’ll keep a list of anything we still need.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I can help out with the repair drive if you need another set of hands.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That would really help—thank you. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got the timing and supplies sorted first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Of course—what timing are you thinking, and what supplies still need to be gathered?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Nell — what’s the repair drive needing most right now?

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Mostly tools and a few extra hands, from what I’ve heard. I’m still getting the updates second-hand, but I can check around if you want.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Thanks, that helps. Can you find out which tools they need most?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard folks are still dropping things off—should be a good turnout.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I’m hoping so — I’ve got a few tools I can lend if anyone needs them.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: That’s generous of you, Gus—people will really appreciate it. I’ll spread the word in case anyone’s looking for tools.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: I’m spreading the word about the repair drive now—want me to put your name on the invite list too?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Yes, please add me to the invite list.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely — I’ll add you to the invite list right away. We’d love to have you there!

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Absolutely — I’m happy to help with the repair drive. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, you’re still willing to help with the repair drive, right?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, absolutely — I’m still willing to help with the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Hi Bo, I’m getting the repair drive organized and I’d love your help. Do you want to take a look at the list with me?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sure, I can take a quick look.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thanks, Bo — I appreciate it. Let’s go through the list together and see what needs the most help.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m heading over to the repair drive later, and I’ll tell the others the plan too.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Vik. Let me know the time and I’ll stick to the plan.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’ll check the time and let you know soon, and I’ll pass it along to the others too.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh right—the repair drive. I’m a bit foggy on the details, but I’m happy to help if you tell me what needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Oren. It’s mostly small things—loose hinges, a leaky tap, and a few broken shelves.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: That sounds manageable—I can probably tackle a hinge or shelf if you point me to it. The tap might be trickier, but I’m happy to lend a hand.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in. What do you need from me?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’d be a huge help, Jules—if you can spread the word and point anyone handy my way, I’d appreciate it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll mention it to folks and send anyone handy your way. Just let me know if you want me to share any details or timing.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Dane, I’m passing the word around for the repair drive tonight—want me to save you a spot?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Yeah, save me a spot — I’ll probably join a little late.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Absolutely, I’ll save you a spot and I’ll let folks know you’re coming late.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard about the repair drive—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I could use help sorting the tools and keeping the list in order. If you’re free, we can start with the small fixes first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I’m free. I can help sort the tools and keep the list straight while we start on the small fixes.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule—what time are you thinking for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: That would be wonderful — maybe late Saturday morning, around 10?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: 10 works for me—I can help line things up around that time.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I can help spread the word about the repair drive and connect folks who might want to pitch in.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Great, I’ll keep repeating the plan around the neighborhood and let people know you’re helping spread the word.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll do my part and keep an ear out for anyone who wants to help.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Sure thing — I can lend a hand with tools if you need them for the repair drive.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’m just trying to make sure we’ve got enough tools and a clear plan before the repair drive starts.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Happy to help you sort it out — I can bring a few basics and help check the tool list before it starts.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I’m not sure yet—where should I head for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Head over to the community center on Maple Street — we’re set up there from 10 to 2.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Got it — I’ll head to the community center on Maple Street between 10 and 2.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hi Hana — what’s the repair drive looking for, and when do you need it by?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hi Mina — I’m looking for clean, working household items and a few basic tools. If you can, I’d need them by this weekend.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Got it — I can probably find a few things. What kind of tools are you short on?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Sure thing — I can help out with the repair drive. What do you need me to do?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Thanks, Sam — we need a few things: screws, duct tape, and a couple of hand tools. If you can bring whatever you’ve got, that’d be a big help.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: I can do that — I’ll bring some screws, duct tape, and a couple hand tools if I have them. See you there.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Oh, I heard the repair drive’s getting organized, but I’m still catching up on the details. If you know what’s needed, I’m happy to help.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, yeah, the repair drive — I’ve only heard bits and pieces too. I can check around and let you know what they still need.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That’d be great, thanks — I’ll keep an ear out too in case I hear anything.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: So, the repair drive is still on for today, right?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Yep, it’s still on for today — I heard folks are bringing tools and snacks by the community center. If you want, I can swing by with you.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Great, just wanted to make sure. What time are we meeting there?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Sounds good — I’ll keep an ear out while I’m out running errands.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Ira. I really appreciate that.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: No problem — I’ll let you know if I hear anything useful.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: I can help with the repair drive—what needs doing first?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Thanks, Leo — I think first we need to sort the tools and see what’s actually broken. I always forget the order, but that should be the start.
